models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sound System Data Set incorrect or doesn't match Vehicle Equipment
stepByStepSolution: Perform Software Version Management (SVM) check on installed Components.
technicalNotes: If the Control Module has been retrofitted and the cars original control module didn't come with such an option, the Software Version Management (SVM) check will not solve the problem. So far there is no other way known to fix this problem.
